items.note: ⚠ OCR. Colophon verse: Shri Bhoja-pati wrote the vritti on the sutras; closing colophon names Dhareshvara Bhojadeva as author of the Rajamartanda Patanjala-vritti.
items.gloss: Having attained the lotus-mouth of the teacher, Shri Bhoja-pati wrote the commentary on the sutras. Thus ends the Kaivalya-pada, the fourth, of the Patanjala-vritti called Rajamartanda, composed by Shri Dhareshvara Bhojadeva.
